summary: b⁻¹b′ is integral at w and block triangular, so its string diagonal entry β_i⁻¹β′_i is integral.

steps.claim: b⁻¹b′ = (b⁻¹g)(g⁻¹g′)(g′⁻¹b′) is integral at w (a product of integral matrices: the lattice conditions of h, h′ and e), and it is block triangular, so its (i, i) string entry β_i⁻¹·β′_i (mul_apply_string_of_blockTriangular, inv) is integral at w: ideleLogVal(β′_i)_w ≤ ideleLogVal(β_i)_w.
steps.lean:
simpa [mul_apply_string_of_blockTriangular h.inv.1 h'.1, h.inv.3, h'.3, field,
    zero_lt_iff, -coe_units_inv] using (v.valuationSubring.1.comap (evalAt w)).matrix.mul_mem
    (mul_mem (mem_intGL_Ô.1 h.2 w).isIntMatrix e) (mem_intGL_Ô.1 h'.2 w).isIntMatrix_inv
    (Y.indexEquiv (.inr i)) (Y.indexEquiv (.inr i))
